description: Echoes of Orbit tells the stories of NASA’s abandoned rovers & probes on the Moon and Mars for school-age space fans. 🚀 Website, design & videos are covered. We need: ✍️ a writer, 🔍 a fact-checker, 🛰️ a space nerd, 🎓 a kid-friendly explainer. Early members get real say in the story. Beginners welcome! Join request: tell us your favorite abandoned spacecraft.
